title: Ollie and the Heart Pebble
markdown:
There once was a little otter named Ollie. Ollie had very wiggly whiskers and bright eyes, like buttons. He loved to tumble and play, and his tail thumped with joy on the soft, grassy riverbank. His best friend in all the whole wide world was Bear-Bear, a cuddly teddy bear. Bear-Bear was as soft as a freshly baked bun and as patient as a sunny afternoon. They lived in a cozy little den right by a sparkling, giggling river, where the sunlight danced on the water and the air smelled like sweet flowers.

One bright, beautiful morning, Ollie woke up with a wiggle of his nose and a happy little sound. He ran over to Bear-Bear, who was sitting on a soft pillow, looking happy. "Bear-Bear!" Ollie squeaked, his tail giving a little thump-thump-thump on the mossy floor. "Let's go on a very, very special adventure today!"

Bear-Bear blinked his two shiny button eyes, which always looked so kind. "An adventure, Ollie?" he said softly, his voice like a gentle breeze. "Oh, what sort of wonderful adventure shall we have?"

"A heart pebble adventure!" Ollie declared, his whiskers twitching. He did a little happy hop. "I heard the river sprites whispering. They said there are smooth, shiny pebbles. They are shaped just like hearts! They are hidden by the river." That would be the most wonderful treasure to find!

Bear-Bear liked Ollie's exciting ideas. He nodded slowly and gently. "A heart pebble adventure," he echoed, feeling comfy inside. "That sounds just perfectly lovely, Ollie. I do like pebbles."

So, Ollie, with his sleek fur, and Bear-Bear, with his fluffy stuffing, waddled happily down to the water's edge. The river was very clear, and tiny waves tickled their paws. Ollie couldn't resist a good splash! With a joyful "SPLASH-A-ROO!" he slid into the cool, clear water. Ollie loved to splash! Bear-Bear had a special stone. He sat snugly on a big, smooth, flat stone that floated at the edge of the water, like a little boat, perfectly safe and sound.

Ollie paddled along, his bright eyes looking at all the pebbles near the bank, looking for something truly special. He saw pebbles that were round like little moons, and pebbles that were flat like pancakes, and pebbles that were bumpy like tiny sleeping hedgehogs.

"Hmm," Ollie murmured to himself, looking very, very closely at each one. "This one is too round, like a ball. And this one is too long, like a stick… They are not hearts. Not yet. Not yet." He swam a little closer to the bank, his little otter nose sniffing the air for the pebble.

Bear-Bear, sitting so still and watching Ollie with his patient gaze, wiggled his button nose. "Look, Ollie!" he said clearly. "Over there, near the green weeds! There's a very shiny one peeking out!"

Ollie’s ears perked up! He paddled with a happy flick of his tail towards where Bear-Bear was pointing. And oh my goodness, there, amongst the green weeds, was a pebble like no other. It was smooth and shaped like a perfect heart. "It's a heart!" Ollie squeaked with pure happiness. His voice bubbled with joy. "Oh, Bear-Bear, it's a heart-shaped pebble! A real one!"

It truly was. A lovely, smooth pebble, shining brightly in the warm sunshine, perfectly shaped like a sweet, little heart. Ollie gently picked it up. With very careful paws and a proud little puff of his chest, he pushed it into the little pouch he wore around his neck, his special treasure pouch.

"We found one!" Ollie giggled and swirled in the water. Droplets sparkled everywhere. "The best, shiny heart pebble in the river!"

Bear-Bear gave a happy sigh from his floating stone, a happy sound like a soft purr. "It is a very special pebble, Ollie," he agreed, his button eyes twinkling. "It is perfect."

And wouldn't you know it, with their precious heart-shaped pebble safe in Ollie’s pouch, and their hearts feeling happy, like a warm hug, Ollie and Bear-Bear decided it was time to go home. The sun felt like a warm blanket on their fur and stuffing, and the river giggled along with them. They had found their special treasure, and the very best part of all was sharing the wonderful adventure, side by side, friend to friend.
characters: Ollie the otter pup, Bear-Bear the teddy
